Questions & answers

What's included with Notion?

We recommend our Business or Enterprise plans for companies. Both include the full Notion platform—docs, databases, integrations, API/MCP, and enterprise-grade security—plus all AI capabilities: Meeting Notes, Enterprise Search, Deep Research, AI Writer, and Agents. All in one connected AI-powered workspace.

Does Notion have Enterprise-grade security?

Yes. Learn more at notion.com/security or notion.com/help/notion-ai-security-practices. For specific requirements, your Sales Representative can provide access to our Security Portal under NDA.

How can I migrate to Notion?

Notion's Confluence Importer makes it easy to bring your work over—whether you're moving a few projects or your entire workspace. For larger migrations, we recommend connecting with your Sales Representative to go through our Migration Assessment. This helps us understand your needs and figure out the best way to support your transition.

Does Notion integrate with JIRA?

Yes! Notion integrates with JIRA in multiple ways — from seamless search and link previews to full database syncing with real-time updates. Our new 2-way sync even lets you edit work items (Owner, Status, Priority) and add comments directly in Notion, with changes automatically reflected in JIRA.

I'm currently using Confluence on-prem and need to migrate, how can Notion help?

Atlassian's Data Center sunset means you'll migrate either way. With Notion you can consolidate docs, projects, and AI into one connected workspace people actually adopt. Schedule time with our Sales team to review your requirements and see how we can support your migration.
